basic_info.description: Rarely available top floor one-bedroom condominium in heart of the Marina. Located directly across from the Great Meadow at Fort Mason, walking distance to the vibrant shops, restaurants, and parks the Marina is known for. Natural light floods the oversized living space, highlighting the perfect balance of period details and modern updates. A large foyer greats you upon entering the home, creating a sense of space and gracefulness. The oversized living room features a wall of south facing windows overlooking the neighboring landscaped garden and up to the peaks of Pacific Heights. A dedicated dining room space offers room to entertain. The large bedroom, with south facing windows, is large enough for a king bed and dedicated office area. The walk-in closet features new Elfa custom closets. Chef's kitchen features top-of-the-line appliances, wine fridge, ample counter space and a spacious layout perfect for culinary enthusiasts. The elegant cabinetry and stylish finishes provide both functionality and aesthetic appeal, making it a true centerpiece for any home. In-unit laundry and one car parking spot in the garage. Interiors of the unit were painted and new floors installed in 2024. Rear exterior of building painted this year. Not in liquefaction. 95 Walk score and 97 Bike score.
